summary.text: Matt Loesby is the Libertarian Party nominee for U.S. Senate in Idaho. A software engineer and video game developer, he ran as the Libertarian candidate for Idaho's 1st Congressional District in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Earned a bachelor's degree from Chapman University in 2010.
Works as a software engineer. In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey he described himself as a video game developer and software engineer.
Was the Libertarian candidate for Idaho's 1st Congressional District in 2024, receiving 9,594 votes (2.1%) in a race won by Rep. Russ Fulcher.
Advanced unopposed from the May 19, 2026 Libertarian primary for U.S. Senate with 855 votes.
